title: 35. Can I generate the order of answers in a single or multiple choice question?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: Can I generate the order of answers in a single or multiple choice question.
short_answer: When creating a single or multiple choice question, you will have the option to generate their answers in three different ways:
procedure: Original Order Alphabetical Order Random Order
Original Order: This option will display the original order of your answers on the survey.
Alphabetical Order: You can select this option if the answers should be displayed alphabetically on the survey.
Random Order: You can choose this option if the answers should be randomly displayed on the survey.
